title: New claims start from the newest Susi landing
goal: `cargo local-workflow start` based every claim on the local integration ref even when the fetched origin/main (where `local-snapshot submit` lands work) had moved past it, so claims started from a stale tree and a worktree whose work landed through the publisher could not be reused. The base is now the fetched origin/main when it descends from the integration ref.
